nodes.description: Private mapping of holder balances; mutated by _transfer, _approveCheck, _mint and _burn.
Whitelist mapping controlling which senders bypass the burnTokenCheck transfer restrictions.
Blacklist mapping used to block senders inside burnTokenCheck and set by addApprove.
Threshold/state used by burnTokenCheck to decide whether a transfer is above the allowed sell amount.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances; written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Privileged owner address that gates _mint and all administrative mutators.
Secondary privileged address consulted by the burnTokenCheck modifier; reassignable via decreaseAllowance.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address that receives maximum approvals in multiTransfer.
Constructor setting _name, _symbol, _decimals, _owner, _safeOwner and minting the initial supply.
ERC20 transfer that delegates to _approveCheck after a _msgSender() lookup.
Owner-only batch transfer that whitelists receivers and grants them max allowance to _unirouter.
Allowance-based transfer; calls _approveCheck then deducts the spender allowance.
Sets an allowance for the caller via _approve.
Owner-only loop that whitelists addresses and removes them from the blacklist.
Owner-only function that overwrites the _safeOwner privileged address.
Owner-only loop that blacklists addresses and removes them from the whitelist.
Internal unrestricted transfer moving balances with SafeMath and emitting Transfer.
Public mint guarded only by msg.sender == _owner; increases total supply and owner balance.
Internal burn reducing both the account balance and the total supply.
Internal allowance writer that validates owner/spender and emits Approval.
Guarded transfer implementation using the burnTokenCheck modifier before moving balances.
Modifier with deeply nested branches that can mutate _sellAmount, _safeOwner and the blacklist and can block transfers.
Empty hook invoked before every token movement.
View getter returning the raw balance of an account.
View getter returning the stored allowance for an owner/spender pair.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and as the implicit sender in transfer paths.
Batch approval of 2^256-1 allowance of receivers' tokens to the hardcoded _unirouter address.
Privileged supply inflation: _mint can create arbitrary tokens once msg.sender equals _owner.
decreaseAllowance(address) lets the owner overwrite _safeOwner, re-pointing the transfer-gating privilege.
Nested conditional gate that can silently blacklist senders, change _sellAmount and revert transfers.
Balance and supply arithmetic via SafeMath add/sub whose surrounding branch conditions are opaque.

edges.reason: multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before whitelisting and approving receivers.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before mutating whitelist/blacklist.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before overwriting _safeOwner.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner before blacklisting addresses.
_mint is guarded only by msg.sender == _owner, allowing privileged supply inflation.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the implicit sender passed to _approveCheck.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is deducted.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_approveCheck debits and credits _balances.
_mint adds the minted amount to the owner balance in _balances.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from _balances.
balanceOf returns _balances[account].
multiTransfer marks receivers as whitelisted in _whiteAddress.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receiver] = true.
burnTokenCheck reads and can clear _whiteAddress when blacklisting a sender.
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receiver] = true.
burnTokenCheck reads and can set _blackAddress to block a sender.
burnTokenCheck compares the transfer amount against _sellAmount.
burnTokenCheck writes _sellAmount when owner sends to itself.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
transferFrom reads and reduces the stored allowance.
allowance returns _allowances[owner][spender].
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
Constructor assigns the owner argument to _owner.
_owner gates the privileged mint operation.
burnTokenCheck branches on comparisons against _owner to authorize or block transfers.
decreaseAllowance overwrites the privileged _safeOwner address.
burnTokenCheck uses _safeOwner to allow transfers and to reassign the safe owner.
multiTransfer approves receivers' tokens to the hardcoded _unirouter.
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply for the owner.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _approveCheck.
multiTransfer calls transfer for each receiver/amount pair.
multiTransfer calls _approve to grant the router allowance.
transferFrom moves tokens through _approveCheck.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance via _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance performs the owner-controlled _safeOwner reassignment.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_approveCheck is gated by the burnTokenCheck modifier before any state change.
_approveCheck invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_approveCheck computes new balances with SafeMath sub/add operations.
The nested branches of burnTokenCheck form the transfer authorization gate.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter name is consumed only by the constructor when setting _name.
Constructor parameter symbol is consumed only by the constructor when setting _symbol.
Constructor parameter initialSupply is scaled and minted inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter owner initializes the privileged _owner and _safeOwner.
transfer recipient is forwarded straight into _approveCheck.
transfer amount is forwarded straight into _approveCheck.
approvecount only bounds the whitelisting loop inside multiTransfer.
receivers array is only iterated inside multiTransfer.
amounts array only feeds the transfer calls inside multiTransfer.
approve spender is only passed to _approve.
approve amount is only passed to _approve.
transferFrom sender is only used inside transferFrom and its _approveCheck call.
transferFrom recipient is only used inside transferFrom and its _approveCheck call.
transferFrom amount is only used for the transfer and allowance deduction.
receivers array is only iterated by increaseAllowance.
safeOwner parameter is written into the privileged _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance.
receivers array is only iterated by addApprove.
_transfer sender is the debited address handled by the internal transfer.
_transfer recipient is the credited address handled by the internal transfer.
_transfer amount is applied to the balances inside the internal transfer.
_approveCheck sender flows into the guarded transfer and the modifier.
_approveCheck recipient flows into the guarded transfer and the modifier.
_approveCheck amount flows into the guarded transfer and the modifier.
_mint account is only used for the emitted Transfer event.
_mint amount is the supply inflated by the privileged mint.
_burn account is the debited address of the burn.
_burn amount is subtracted from balance and total supply.
_approve owner is the allowance key written by the internal approve.
_approve spender is the allowance key written by the internal approve.
_approve amount is the allowance value stored.
burnTokenCheck sender drives every branch of the transfer gate.
burnTokenCheck recipient drives the owner/router branches of the gate.
burnTokenCheck amount is compared with _sellAmount inside the gate.
Loop counter i exists only inside multiTransfer.
Loop counter i exists only inside increaseAllowance.
Loop counter i exists only inside addApprove.
